title: Foreman-E Worker Pool
description: Foreman-E coordinates workers 081-100 as one aggregated pool. The room shows pool summaries plus only important worker exceptions.

messages.text: Workers 081-100 handle staging, temporary access, path markers, and diff collection. Every temporary block must carry a tmp/* tag.

messages.systemLog: Tools Call: channel.open: Foreman-E assigns staging, cleanup, and diff collection to workers 081-100.

messages.text: The pool repeated safe block placement enough times to learn Place: a guarded block-placement SKILL with bounds check, air_check, and rollback metadata. Publishing it to the shared library now.

messages.systemLog: Skill Scheduler: Place is committed to the Shared Skill Library from Foreman-E Worker Pool and shared to Foreman-A, Foreman-B, Foreman-C, Foreman-D, and Foreman-E worker rooms.

messages.text: Cleanup pattern learned. Worker-091 publishes Remove: a guarded SKILL for deleting temporary blocks by tmp/* tag after checking ownership and rollback safety.
Pool E complete. All diff shards are collected, the temporary tag ledger is closed, and final cleanup has zero unknown temporary blocks.

messages.systemLog: Skill Scheduler: Remove is committed to the Shared Skill Library from Foreman-E cleanup and shared to all Foreman worker rooms for deterministic temporary-block cleanup.
Tools Call: channel.close: Foreman-E closes the temporary ledger and submits collected diff shards.
